title: Run record, version 1
description: Immutable record of one run under SPEC-0005: a complete search record plus the provenance needed to repeat it. Verification re-runs the search from this document and compares the two records; agreement is evidence of determinism, never a proof of optimality.

revision.description: Source revision as 40 lowercase hexadecimal digits. The all-zero revision marks an example that is not measurement evidence.

dirty.description: Whether the working tree differed from the recorded revision. A dirty record identifies a source state no revision can reconstruct, so it must not be presented as reproducible evidence.

hardware.description: Host the run executed on. Field names match experiment-result-v1 so the two provenance shapes cannot drift apart.

gpu_uuid.description: Null for a CPU run. This surface performs no GPU work.

toolchain.description: Build tooling of the binary that performed the run.

model_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the canonical original model document. This identifies model bytes, not model identity: a record whose model was edited under an unchanged model_id is refused before any search runs.

inputs.description: Input documents with the hashes of the bytes actually read. Exactly one model and one config document are required.

path.description: Path as the caller supplied it, for diagnosis rather than resolution.

warnings.description: Run-level warnings, retained even on success.
